description: Pre-payment signals for a seller. Use when an agent is about to pay a seller it has not dealt with and wants plain signals first: domain age from RDAP, whether HTTPS works, DNS and email authentication, whether a payTo address is well formed, and whether the site publishes terms and a refund policy. Signals only: not a guarantee, not legal or financial advice. Cost: 3 credits per call.

domain.description: The seller's domain. A URL is accepted and its host is used. Use the seller's main domain where you can: a subdomain or a shop on a shared platform gives a less complete answer, because the registry only knows its parent.

network.description: The CAIP-2 network for pay_to, such as eip155:8453.

pay_to.description: The address the agent has been asked to pay. Format checked only.

name: seller_check
